name: unsafe fn try_borrow_unguarded (& self) -> Result < & T , BorrowError >
rule: For safety, the RefCell must not be mutably borrowed while a reference returned by try_borrow_unguarded is alive.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::cell::RefCell < T > { unsafe fn try_borrow_unguarded (& self) -> core::result::Result < & T , core::cell::BorrowError > }
